hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS" | tr ',' '\n' | while read -r file_path; do if echo "$file_path" | grep -qE '\.(ts|tsx|vue|js|jsx|mjs|json|css|html)$'; then npx prettier --write "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done

jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git\s+push.*--force|git\s+push\s+-f'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Force push is not allowed. Use regular push.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git\s+push.*main|git\s+push.*master'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Direct push to main/master is not allowed. Push to your feature branch.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0; }
